messages:
nitya: quick note 0 seeing flaky schema failures from a new int8 canary. Looks like retries + streaming produce a trailing "," or duplicate entry in tool_calls.

cole: how frequent? any sample?

nitya: ~0.4% of requests on canary. Example post-merge buffer: 
... \"tool_calls\": [{\"id\":\"t1\",\"name\":\"search\"}, , {\"id\":\"t2\",\"name\":\"parse\"}] ...

morgan: double-comma again. Likely serializer wrote separator then a retry reset didn't clear separator flag.

jen: short-term we can add a canary linter that validates NDJSON/JSON array after merge and fails the canary. Also add telemetry metric structured_malformed_count.

nitya: long-term fix: make serializer transactional (only emit separator after append success) + dedupe tool_call.id before final emit. Also patch retry path to clear separator state on reset.

cole: I'll own the transactional serializer PR. jen, can you add the linter and metric?

opsbot: Created ticket INF-3560 and assigned cole and jen. https://internal/ops/INF-3560 :white_check_mark:

nitya: repro script ready in eng-ml/canary-repro/retry-sep-repro.sh, will upload and ping when PRs are up. Thanks!
